_comment: The status map (docs/gameplay/11_BATTLE_DATA.md §4.2; src/core/game/systems/battle_rules.h): for each fighter's look,
what each status shows: clip (its name in the fighter's .anim; empty: the status's own name), sound (a sound id in
media/sfx) and fx (an effect in media/fx/battle.particle). base: another look whose states this one starts from.
A monster names its look in enemies.json "look" (none: "monster"); the player's is "player".
Statuses: idle, attack, hurt, die, special, transform, parry, broken. A monster's clip is looked up as
